svg.title: A classic tool-use loop beside an interleaved-thinking loop
svg.desc: A hand-drawn comparison of two agent loops. The classic loop runs think, tool, tool, tool, answer: the model picks its next action straight from raw tool output with no room to deliberate, so complex plans have to be forced into an explicit scaffold of prompt-engineered planning steps. The interleaved loop runs think, tool, think, tool, think, answer: deliberation happens inside the model between observations, so it can notice that a result contradicts an earlier one, reconsider its plan, and adjust with no separate planning node. Two panels below divide the trail: keep the observation-action record at full fidelity because it is the durable record of what happened, and treat the thinking between steps as compressible, a prime candidate to drop when compacting tool-use history. A caption notes each thinking segment costs output tokens, so a long loop budgets for many segments rather than one.
svg.text: Thinking stops being one block at the front and becomes deliberation woven between observations.

The deliberation happens inside the model between observations: it can notice that a result contradicts an earlier one, reconsider
its plan, and adjust, with no separate planning node.
The observation-action trail: what the agent did and what it saw.
That is the durable record of what happened.
The thinking between those steps. Prime candidates to drop when you
Each thinking segment between tool calls costs output tokens, so a long interleaved loop budgets for N segments, not one.
